description: Dataset on residential electricity load profiles in Switzerland is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Katharina Kaiser, Markus Kreft (ETH Zurich). Abstract Residential electricity profiles are undergoing significant changes due to the increasing adoption of distributed renewable generation, heat pumps, and electric vehicles. Up-to-date real-world measurements are used to characterize these evolving consumption patterns and provide a timely empirical foundation for research. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
